none: PAS KENT-81484D: Incomplete FEL TEMP REPARATIO reverse type depicting a phoenix on a rock
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn and incomplete copper-alloy Roman nummus (AE3) likely of Constans dating to AD 348-350 (Reece period 18). FEL TEMP REPARATIO reverse type depicting a phoenix on a globe. Uncertain Mint. Obverse: misstruck? Draped and pearl diademed bust facing right. Legend: '[DN C]ONSTA[NS PF AVG]'. Reverse: Phoenix standing on a globe Legend: '[FE]L .[ TE]MP . RE[PARATIO]'. Measurements: 15.16mm in…
